description: Bank income statement skeleton inspired by the supplied JPMorgan reference presentation. All 200 supplied unique concepts are retained exactly once. Presentation families are provisional; nesting and shared categories do not establish arithmetic or concept equivalence.
classification_notes: The supplied list defines the concept universe. No frequency threshold or completeness of bank disclosures has been independently established.
The reference is a presentation guide, not a source of US-GAAP concept equivalence, signs, currency conversion or reported XBRL facts.
No matching supplied concept is assumed for net operating profit, total net revenue after provisions, trust income or foreign exchange income. No mapped placeholder or calculated total is invented.
InterestIncomeExpenseAfterProvisionForLoanLoss is narrower than total net revenue after provisions because it excludes noninterest income.
Every supplied concept has a separate node to retain measurement distinctions. Totals and components can overlap; no aggregation is prescribed.
Expense and loss signs depend on facts and presentation. contra=false does not assert a positive sign or preclude an expense deduction.
Review mappings require filing context before calculations. Even proposed mappings require issuer-specific dimensions, scope and taxonomy-version checks.

metadata_contract.period_type: Taxonomy periodType, independently verified for each supplied concept.
metadata_contract.unit_type: monetary, shares or per_share as specified by the taxonomy type; no unit conversion is implied.
metadata_contract.contra: False for these income statement facts. Expense deductions and signed gain/loss presentation require fact context; contra is not a sign multiplier.

taxonomy_reference.note: Period and unit metadata verified against the local copy of the official 2026 schema. Historical filings require their own taxonomy and unit checks.

nodes.label: Bank revenue
nodes.classification_note: Net interest income combines signed interest income and expense, while noninterest income is a separate revenue stream. Generic revenue alternatives can overlap these streams and are not additional revenue.

children.label: Interest and dividend income
children.classification_note: InterestAndDividendIncomeOperating and InterestIncomeOperating are alternative reported aggregates with different dividend coverage. The adjacent loan, interbank, securities and other groups are potentially overlapping breakdowns, not additional amounts to add to either total.

children.label: Interest and fees on loans and leases
children.classification_note: All-loan interest and fee income can include held-in-portfolio and held-for-sale amounts. These scope alternatives must be reconciled rather than added together.

children.label: Interest and fee income loans and leases
Interest and fee income loans and leases held in portfolio
Interest and fee income loans and leases held for sale
Interest on interbank balances and resale agreements
children.classification_note: Federal funds sold can already be included in the combined federal-funds-and-resale-agreements amount. Bank-deposit income has a different counterparty/product scope; inspect issuer breakdowns before aggregation.

children.label: Interest income on federal funds sold and resale agreements
Interest income deposits with financial institutions
Interest and dividends on securities
children.classification_note: Taxability, security type and accounting portfolio are intersecting classifications. Broad securities income can include narrower HTM, AFS, trading, municipal or mortgage-backed amounts; do not sum these alternative breakdowns.

children.label: Interest and dividend income securities held to maturity
Interest income debt securities available for sale operating
Interest and dividend income securities other
Interest income securities state and municipal

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInterest
concepts.review_reason: Investment interest may be reported within interest income. Verify the issuer presentation and avoid overlap with securities interest totals.

children.label: Interest income debt securities trading operating
Other interest and dividend income
children.classification_note: OtherInterestAndDividendIncome includes dividend income whereas InterestIncomeOther may not. Establish issuer scope before selecting either residual measure.

children.label: Interest expense
children.classification_note: InterestExpense and InterestExpenseOperating are alternative reported totals. Deposit, interbank, borrowing and other groups are contextual breakdowns that may overlap the totals or each other; do not add a total to those breakdowns.

children.label: Interest on deposits
children.classification_note: Deposit interest totals overlap product, domestic-office and time-deposit size breakdowns. NOW, money-market and savings combined amounts overlap the individual product amounts; do not sum intersecting classifications.

children.label: Interest expense on time deposits of $100,000 or more
Interest expense on time deposits below $100,000
Interest expense on NOW, money market and savings deposits
Interest expense negotiable order of withdrawal NOW deposits
Interest on federal funds and repurchase agreements
children.classification_note: The combined federal-funds-purchased and repurchase-agreement amount overlaps both separately disclosed components. Select the combined measure or a reconciled breakdown.

children.label: Interest expense on federal funds purchased and repurchase agreements
Interest expense securities sold under agreements to repurchase
Interest on borrowings and debt
children.classification_note: Borrowings and debt totals overlap maturity, instrument and lender breakdowns. Subordinated, junior subordinated and trust-preferred categories may be nested; do not assume mutually exclusive components.

children.label: Interest expense on long-term FHLB and Federal Reserve advances
Interest expense on short-term FHLB and Federal Reserve advances
Interest expense subordinated notes and debentures
Interest expense other long term debt
Interest expense other short term borrowings
Other interest expense
children.classification_note: Finance lease interest can be included in other interest or debt interest. A residual other-interest amount is not automatically exclusive of the lease disclosure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinanceLeaseInterestExpense
concepts.review_reason: Finance lease interest may overlap debt interest or lease cost disclosures. Confirm inclusion in the reported interest expense total.

children.label: Noninterest income
children.classification_note: Reported noninterest income can already include the fee, trading, investment and other-income disclosures below and elsewhere in this skeleton. Children organize presentation and do not prescribe a sum.

children.label: Fees and commissions
children.classification_note: Investment banking totals can include advisory, underwriting and brokerage fees. Mortgage servicing fees can be included in mortgage banking and servicing totals; categories are not mutually exclusive.

children.label: Fees and commissions mortgage banking and servicing

concepts.name: us-gaap:LoanProcessingFee
concepts.review_reason: Confirm that loan processing fees are recognized as current noninterest income rather than deferred and amortized into interest income.

children.label: Investment banking advisory brokerage and underwriting fees and commissions
Financial asset servicing fees, late fees and ancillary fees
Trading and securities gains and losses
children.classification_note: Trading income can contain security gains and losses shown in the class-specific groups. Groups separate asset classes and measurement views, not additive revenue buckets.

children.label: Debt securities gains and losses
children.classification_note: AFS and all-debt measures overlap. Realized-only, broader gain/loss and loss-only facts are distinct measurement views; do not sum these alternatives.

children.label: Debt securities available for sale realized loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRealizedLoss
concepts.review_reason: Realized AFS debt-security losses alone omit realized gains; use as a loss component rather than the net realized gain/loss measure.

children.label: Debt securities available for sale realized gain loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Net realized AFS debt-security results can already contain the separately supplied realized-loss amount; reconcile the two before selecting this measure.

children.label: Debt securities available for sale gain loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: The AFS debt-security gain/loss label does not identify the realized-only scope used by the supplied realized measure; inspect the applicable taxonomy definition and earnings versus OCI treatment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesRealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Realized debt-security results are not explicitly limited to AFS securities; establish portfolio coverage before selecting between this and the AFS realized measure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Debt-security gain/loss is broader than the explicitly realized and AFS alternatives; determine portfolio and recognition scope before assigning an earnings line.

children.label: AFS debt securities realized gain or loss excluding OTTI

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRealizedGainLossExcludingOtherThanTemporaryImpairment
concepts.review_reason: Explicitly excludes other-than-temporary impairment; preserve this historical measurement distinction from the other supplied AFS realized gain/loss measure.

children.label: Equity securities gains and losses
children.classification_note: Total FV-NI, realized, unrealized net and unrealized gain-only facts overlap. Select the relevant measure; do not sum a total with its components or a gross gain with a net result.

children.label: Equity securities FV-NI unrealized gain loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized equity-security fair-value changes exclude realized disposal results; distinguish this component from the combined FV-NI gain/loss measure.

children.label: Equity securities FV-NI realized gain loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Realized FV-NI equity-security results are distinct from unrealized changes and may already be included in EquitySecuritiesFvNiGainLoss.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Combined FV-NI equity-security results may contain both supplied realized and unrealized amounts; identify the reconciliation rather than treating it as a third component.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedGain
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized FV-NI equity gains alone omit unrealized losses; this is a gross gain component, not the net unrealized gain/loss result.

children.label: Combined debt and equity securities results
children.classification_note: These cross-class measures can contain amounts shown in both debt and equity groups. Realized-only and broader results are alternatives; do not sum them.

children.label: Debt and equity securities gain loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtAndEquitySecuritiesGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Combines debt and equity securities without the explicit realized-only qualification of DebtAndEquitySecuritiesRealizedGainLoss; establish which measurement components are recognized in earnings.

children.label: Debt and equity securities realized gain loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtAndEquitySecuritiesRealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Realized results combine debt and equity classes; reconcile against debt-only and equity-only realized disclosures before using this cross-class amount.

children.label: Investment results with unspecified asset class
children.classification_note: All-investment and other-investment disposal measures may overlap. Gross sale gains, gross sale losses and broader net investment results are not additive alternatives.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Investment gain/loss has broader asset and measurement scope than sale-only gains or losses; identify the covered investments before choosing this aggregate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainOnSaleOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Investment sale gains alone exclude sale losses and non-sale fair-value changes; do not substitute this gross component for GainLossOnInvestments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LossOnSaleOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Investment sale losses alone exclude sale gains; establish whether they are already netted into the reported investment gain/loss measure.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of other investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments
concepts.review_reason: The other-investments sale category excludes investment classes reported elsewhere; identify those exclusions before comparing with all-investment disposal results.

children.label: Other noninterest and operating income
children.classification_note: Other-noninterest and other-operating residuals can be alternative labels for overlapping amounts. Lease income totals can include operating lease income; dividend presentation varies by issuer.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DividendIncomeOperating
concepts.review_reason: Dividend income may be included in interest and dividend income. Confirm issuer presentation before including it in noninterest income.

children.label: Reported revenue alternatives
children.classification_note: Generic revenue concepts require issuer-specific gross/net and scope review; no supplied concept is assumed to equal net revenue in the reference presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Revenues
concepts.review_reason: Determine whether the issuer reports gross revenue or revenue net of interest expense. Do not equate this generic revenue concept with net revenue in the reference presentation.

children.label: Revenue from contract with customer excluding assessed tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax
concepts.review_reason: Contract revenue excludes some banking income streams. Confirm covered services and tax presentation; do not use as total bank revenue.

children.label: Revenue from contract with customer including assessed tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax
concepts.review_reason: Contract revenue includes assessed taxes and excludes some banking income streams. Do not combine with the excluding-tax alternative or use as total bank revenue.

nodes.label: Provision for credit losses
nodes.classification_note: Loan-and-lease provision, loan-only provision and broader loan/lease/other-loss provision have different exposure scopes and can overlap. HTM loss expense with and without accrued interest is also an alternative scope. Reversals remain signed facts; do not sum total and component provisions.

children.label: Provision for loan lease and other losses
Provision for loan and lease losses
Financing receivable excluding accrued interest credit loss expense reversal
Off balance sheet credit loss liability credit loss expense reversal
Debt securities held to maturity credit loss expense reversal
HTM debt securities credit loss expense (reversal), excluding accrued interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts
concepts.review_reason: Provision for doubtful accounts may relate to non-loan receivables. Confirm exposure class and avoid overlap with credit loss provisions.

nodes.label: Net interest income after provision
nodes.classification_note: The supplied concept excludes noninterest income; it cannot represent the reference presentation net revenue after provisions subtotal.

children.label: Net interest income after loan loss provision

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseAfterProvisionForLoanLoss
concepts.review_reason: This is net interest income after loan loss provision, not total net revenue after all credit provisions and noninterest income. Preserve its narrower scope.

nodes.label: Noninterest expense
nodes.classification_note: Reported noninterest expense can contain the expense families below and transaction or impairment disclosures elsewhere. Children are overlapping presentation details, not a calculation tree.

children.label: Labor and related expenses
children.classification_note: LaborAndRelatedExpense can include salary, benefits, pension and share-based compensation components. SalariesAndWages and SalariesWagesAndOfficersCompensation can overlap; do not add alternative salary measures or components to labor totals.

children.label: Employee benefits and share based compensation
Pension and other postretirement benefit expense
Occupancy, equipment and leases
children.classification_note: Occupancy, equipment and lease expenses may overlap. LeaseCost may contain operating and finance lease components, and occupancy may contain rent; reconcile costs before combining them.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LeaseCost
concepts.review_reason: Lease cost may combine operating and finance lease costs, including interest. Do not add the full amount to operating lease expense or interest expense.

children.label: Depreciation and amortization
children.classification_note: Nonproduction depreciation can include depreciation of property held for operating lease. Intangible amortization is a different asset class; identify inclusion in other reported expense totals.

children.label: Depreciation of property subject to or held for operating lease
Technology and communications
children.classification_note: CommunicationsAndInformationTechnology can include Communication and InformationTechnologyAndDataProcessing. The combined amount is an alternative presentation level, not an additional component.

children.label: Professional, legal and litigation expenses
children.classification_note: Professional fees and professional/contract services can include legal fees. Litigation settlement expense is a recognized settlement amount that may already be included in legal or other operating expenses.

children.label: Marketing and advertising
children.classification_note: MarketingAndAdvertisingExpense can include MarketingExpense and AdvertisingExpense, which may also overlap each other by issuer definition. Do not add the combined amount to the narrower measures.

children.label: Insurance and regulatory expenses
children.classification_note: FDIC premiums and general insurance cover different risks but may share an issuer expense line. Establish whether general insurance excludes deposit insurance before combining them.

children.label: Taxes other than income taxes
children.classification_note: TaxesOther has unspecified coverage, whereas TaxesExcludingIncomeAndExciseTaxes explicitly excludes excise taxes. These are alternative tax-scope views, not automatically separate costs.

children.label: Taxes excluding income and excise taxes
Other operating and noninterest expenses
children.classification_note: OtherNoninterestExpense and OtherCostAndExpenseOperating may contain the narrower director, loan portfolio, foreclosed-property, travel or supplies costs. Residual labels do not establish mutually exclusive components.

children.label: Supplies and postage
children.classification_note: SuppliesAndPostageExpense can include both separately reported supplies and postage. These are alternative detail levels; do not add the combined amount to its components.

nodes.label: Reported expense total alternatives
nodes.classification_note: OperatingExpenses is an alternative reported aggregate whose scope may include interest or provisions. It is not a component of NoninterestExpense and must not be added to that total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingExpenses
concepts.review_reason: Generic operating expenses may include interest or provision expenses. Confirm scope before treating as noninterest expense.

nodes.label: Other income and expense requiring presentation context
nodes.classification_note: Items here require issuer presentation context and may already be included in noninterest income or expense. Group placement does not classify them all as nonoperating or as additional adjustments.

children.label: Equity in earnings of affiliates
children.classification_note: Equity-method earnings are an ownership-based result that may be included in noninterest income or separately reported. Disposal gains are retained in the transaction candidates rather than presumed part of recurring affiliate earnings.

children.label: Income loss from equity method investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method earnings may be included in noninterest income or separately presented. Confirm placement before using in a subtotal.

children.label: Other income and expense candidates
children.classification_note: Generic other income/expense and real-estate-specific net results have different coverage. These candidates are not an inferred nonoperating subtotal.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherIncome
concepts.review_reason: Generic other income requires filing context to determine operating classification and overlap with noninterest income.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherExpenses
concepts.review_reason: Generic other expenses require filing context to determine operating, nonoperating, and interest components.

children.label: Profit loss from real estate operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProfitLossFromRealEstateOperations
concepts.review_reason: Real estate operations profit or loss is a business-specific net amount. Confirm whether it is included in operating or noninterest income.

children.label: Other revenue expense from real estate operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherRevenueExpenseFromRealEstateOperations
concepts.review_reason: Real estate revenue/expense is a business-specific measure. Inspect netting and inclusion in other income or expense.

children.label: Loan sales and servicing gains and losses
children.classification_note: Aggregate loan-sale gains can include mortgage, note and other-loan amounts. MSR valuation is a servicing-asset measure; all may already be included in mortgage banking income. Do not add overlapping scopes.

children.label: Gain loss on sales of loans net

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet
concepts.review_reason: Net loan-sale results can cover mortgage and other loan classes supplied separately; establish the covered portfolios before choosing this aggregate.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of mortgage loans

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfMortgageLoans
concepts.review_reason: Mortgage loan disposal results may already be included in mortgage banking and servicing fees; distinguish loan-sale gains from servicing asset results.

children.label: Mortgage servicing rights MSR impairment recovery

concepts.name: us-gaap:MortgageServicingRightsMSRImpairmentRecovery
concepts.review_reason: MSR impairment or recovery is a servicing-asset valuation result, not a mortgage loan-sale gain; identify the servicing income or expense line containing it.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of notes receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Notes-receivable disposals may cover exposures outside the bank loan-sale portfolio; identify the notes and any overlap with net loan-sale results.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of other loans and leases

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherLoansAndLeases
concepts.review_reason: Other loan and lease disposal results exclude loan classes presented separately; establish those exclusions relative to mortgage and total loan-sale results.

children.label: Derivative and fair value disclosures
children.classification_note: Derivative results can overlap net trading income, while fair-value-option changes may cover non-derivative instruments. Earnings recognition, hedge designation, tax basis and OCI treatment must be resolved before selecting a line; these disclosures are not additional revenue.

children.label: Derivative gain loss on derivative net

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeGainLossOnDerivativeNet
concepts.review_reason: This net derivative result does not identify the earnings line or hedge designation in its name; establish those attributes before assigning it to trading income.

children.label: Net gain or loss on derivatives not designated as hedges

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsGainLossNet
concepts.review_reason: Explicitly covers non-designated derivatives; distinguish this result from designated-hedge disclosures and identify inclusion in trading or other income.

children.label: Fair value option gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:FairValueOptionChangesInFairValueGainLoss1
concepts.review_reason: Fair-value-option changes can arise from elected financial assets or liabilities rather than derivatives alone; identify the elected instruments and any separately presented own-credit component.

children.label: Gain loss on derivative instruments net pretax

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax
concepts.review_reason: This derivative result is explicitly pretax; establish whether it is an earnings amount or a hedge-related disclosure before comparing with other derivative results.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of derivatives

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfDerivatives
concepts.review_reason: Derivative disposal results cover sales rather than all period fair-value changes; determine whether they are already included in the reported net derivative result.

children.label: Impairments, transactions and other separate presentation candidates
children.classification_note: Separate presentation is provisional and does not establish nonrecurrence. Transaction costs, impairments, restructuring and settlements may already be included in primary income or expense totals; do not add them again.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill write-downs are distinct from finite-lived intangible impairment; identify inclusion in the reported noninterest expense total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts
concepts.review_reason: Acquisition transaction costs differ from post-acquisition integration costs; identify the expense lines containing advisory, legal or other deal costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: This broad impairment amount can include the separately supplied goodwill and intangible write-downs; determine the asset coverage before selecting it.

children.label: Business combination bargain purchase gain recognized amount

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationBargainPurchaseGainRecognizedAmount
concepts.review_reason: A bargain-purchase gain is acquisition-date income rather than a reduction of acquisition-related expense; identify the line where that gain was recognized.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherRealEstateValuationAdjustments
concepts.review_reason: Valuation adjustments on other real estate may already be included in ForeclosedRealEstateExpense; distinguish write-downs from ongoing property costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationIntegrationRelatedCosts
concepts.review_reason: Integration costs arise from combining operations and can be included in labor, occupancy or other expenses; separate them from acquisition transaction costs.

children.label: Defined benefit plan settlement gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanRecognizedNetGainLossDueToSettlements1
concepts.review_reason: Pension settlement gain/loss is a recognized settlement component that may already be included in pension expense; determine its reported operating or nonoperating line.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestructuringCharges
concepts.review_reason: Restructuring charges can contain the separately supplied severance costs and asset impairments; reconcile those components to the restructuring total.

children.label: Impairment of intangible assets excluding goodwill

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoodwill
concepts.review_reason: Explicitly excludes goodwill and differs from routine intangible amortization; identify the affected intangible assets and expense line.

children.label: Sale and leaseback transaction gain loss net

concepts.name: us-gaap:SaleAndLeasebackTransactionGainLossNet
concepts.review_reason: A sale-and-leaseback disposal result differs from subsequent lease cost and interest; determine the recognized transaction gain/loss separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LossContingencyLossInPeriod
concepts.review_reason: A recognized contingency loss can include litigation amounts disclosed separately; identify the contingency and distinguish recognized expense from exposure estimates.

children.label: Equity method investment realized gain loss on disposal

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentRealizedGainLossOnDisposal
concepts.review_reason: Disposal gain/loss on an equity-method investment differs from recurring equity-method earnings; identify whether the disposal result is included in the reported affiliate-income line.

children.label: Gain loss on sales of assets and asset impairment charges

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: Combines asset disposal results with impairment charges; identify the included asset classes and reconcile separately disclosed write-downs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SeveranceCosts1
concepts.review_reason: Employee termination costs can already be included in labor or restructuring charges; identify which reported total contains this severance component.

nodes.label: Pretax income measures
nodes.classification_note: The two pretax concepts have different equity-method and historical presentation qualifications. Select the measure matching issuer scope rather than summing them.

children.label: Continuing operations income before tax, extraordinary items and NCI

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesExtraordinaryItemsNoncontrollingInterest
concepts.review_reason: Confirm the historical taxonomy definition and consolidation scope before selecting this pretax income total.

children.label: Continuing operations income before tax, minority interest and equity-method income

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesMinorityInterestAndIncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: This pretax measure also excludes equity-method investment income; it is not interchangeable with a pretax total that includes that income.

nodes.label: Income tax expense and components
nodes.classification_note: IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit is the reported total. Current and jurisdiction-specific components in the nested group are partial, potentially overlapping disclosures rather than equivalent totals.

children.label: Current and jurisdiction-specific income taxes
children.classification_note: These are partial tax views across timing and jurisdiction axes. Current federal/state/local taxes can overlap current total tax and federal taxes; do not sum these disclosures or substitute them for total income tax expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CurrentIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit
concepts.review_reason: Current tax excludes the deferred tax component of total income tax expense; reconcile it with total tax rather than treating it as an equivalent measure.

children.label: Federal income tax expense benefit continuing operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:FederalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOperations
concepts.review_reason: Federal continuing-operations tax excludes non-federal jurisdictions and may include current and deferred amounts; it is not equivalent to all-jurisdiction current tax or total tax expense.

children.label: Current federal state and local tax expense benefit

concepts.name: us-gaap:CurrentFederalStateAndLocalTaxExpenseBenefit
concepts.review_reason: Current federal, state and local tax excludes deferred tax and may omit foreign current tax; establish domestic coverage relative to CurrentIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.

nodes.label: Income from continuing operations
nodes.classification_note: Continuing-operations measures differ in explicit noncontrolling-interest scope. They are alternative attribution views, not additive income components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperations
concepts.review_reason: Confirm continuing-operations attribution and consolidation scope; do not equate with the explicitly inclusive alternative.

children.label: Continuing operations income including noncontrolling interests

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
concepts.review_reason: Includes continuing-operations income attributable to noncontrolling interests; do not equate with a parent-only measure.

nodes.label: Discontinued operations
nodes.classification_note: Pretax, tax and net-of-tax amounts are distinct overlapping measures, with potentially different attribution scopes.

children.label: Discontinued operation income loss from discontinued operation before income tax
Discontinued operation tax effect of discontinued operation
Income loss from discontinued operations net of tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTax
concepts.review_reason: Confirm discontinued-operations attribution and scope before choosing between this measure and the reporting-entity alternative.

children.label: Discontinued operations income, net of tax, attributable to the reporting entity

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxAttributableToReportingEntity
concepts.review_reason: Discontinued-operations income attributable to the reporting entity; do not equate with a measure including noncontrolling interests.

nodes.label: Net income and attribution
nodes.classification_note: ProfitLoss is a consolidated measure; reporting-entity income and noncontrolling-interest attribution provide a reconciliation view. Do not sum the consolidated measure with its attribution amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProfitLoss
concepts.review_reason: Consolidated profit or loss includes noncontrolling interests. Do not substitute for income attributable to the reporting parent.

children.label: Net income loss attributable to noncontrolling interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
concepts.review_reason: Income attributable to noncontrolling interests is an attribution amount, not an operating expense. Reconcile its sign with consolidated and parent income.

children.label: Net income (loss) attributable to the reporting entity

concepts.name: us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss
concepts.review_reason: Confirm attribution to the reporting entity and reconcile noncontrolling interests before comparing with consolidated ProfitLoss.

nodes.label: Income available to common shareholders
nodes.classification_note: Preferred adjustments and participating-security allocations affect EPS numerators in different ways. Basic and diluted common-shareholder income are alternative numerator measures; do not subtract adjustments twice.

children.label: Preferred dividends and numerator adjustments
children.classification_note: PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustments can include dividend and redemption-related amounts supplied separately. Preserve the total-versus-component distinction when reconciling common-shareholder income.

children.label: Preferred stock dividends income statement impact
Preferred stock dividends and other adjustments
Participating-security earnings allocations
children.classification_note: Two-class EPS allocations belong to participating securities, separately from preferred dividends. Reconcile with the basic common-shareholder numerator; do not deduct an allocation already reflected there.

children.label: Undistributed earnings or loss allocated to participating securities — basic EPS

concepts.name: us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsLossAllocatedToParticipatingSecuritiesBasic
concepts.review_reason: Participating-security earnings allocation affects the basic EPS numerator; it is not a separate operating expense.

children.label: Net income loss available to common stockholders basic
Net income loss available to common stockholders diluted

nodes.label: Earnings per share
nodes.classification_note: Basic and diluted EPS use different denominators. Continuing and discontinued EPS are component scopes; do not sum them with total EPS or combine basic and diluted measures.

children.label: Income loss from continuing operations per basic share
Income loss from continuing operations per diluted share
Income loss from discontinued operations net of tax per basic share
Income loss from discontinued operations net of tax per diluted share

nodes.label: Weighted-average shares and dilution disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Basic and diluted weighted-average denominators are alternatives. Incremental share-based-payment shares can be included in the diluted-share adjustment; shares issued can differ from shares outstanding because of treasury shares. Reconcile rather than summing these disclosures.

children.label: Weighted average number of shares outstanding basic
Weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding
Incremental common shares attributable to share based payment arrangements
Weighted average number diluted shares outstanding adjustment

concepts.name: us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesIssuedBasic
concepts.review_reason: Weighted-average shares issued can differ from shares outstanding because of treasury shares. Do not substitute for the basic EPS denominator.

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Geographic, AOCI, indemnification, retained-earnings and excluded-security disclosures have different purposes. They are not additional current-period earnings lines or EPS denominator components.

children.label: Domestic continuing operations income before tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesDomestic
concepts.review_reason: Domestic pretax income is a geographic subset, not consolidated pretax income.

children.label: AOCI reclassification, net of tax, attributable to parent

concepts.name: us-gaap:ReclassificationFromAociCurrentPeriodNetOfTaxAttributableToParent
concepts.review_reason: Net-of-tax AOCI reclassification disclosure, not additional net income. Identify the affected income-statement lines and avoid counting reclassified amounts twice.

children.label: Reclassification from AOCI current period tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:ReclassificationFromAociCurrentPeriodTax
concepts.review_reason: Tax effect of AOCI reclassifications, not total income tax expense. Identify affected lines and avoid double counting.

children.label: FDIC indemnification asset period increase decrease

concepts.name: us-gaap:FDICIndemnificationAssetPeriodIncreaseDecrease
concepts.review_reason: Change in an FDIC indemnification asset can include non-income movements. Inspect the rollforward and recognized earnings component before mapping to income.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UndistributedEarnings
concepts.review_reason: Undistributed earnings is supplementary and must not be substituted for current-period consolidated income or the EPS participating-security allocation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AntidilutiveSecuritiesExcludedFromComputationOfEarningsPerShareAmount
concepts.review_reason: Antidilutive securities are excluded from diluted EPS. This is supplementary and must not be added to the diluted denominator.
